name: Lone square pier 901
prompt: a freestanding fragment of a stone aqueduct, one arch on weathered piers with a broken water channel on top, lone square pier, tall, about two people high, completely unlit, no glow, no light sources, no self-emission

placement.note: Render the sprite scaled so its height == world_px_height; a character is character_height_px tall.

adopted: recovered from the PixelLab store 2026-08-13: runs 5/6 were cancelled mid-pass and their committed-but-unpushed art died with the runners; the store object survived. Index 900+ band avoids colliding with the concurrently-running pass.
recovered_spec: metadata restored by replaying run 5's deterministic planner at its checkout (a21c4bc8); orphan creation order matched the planned sequence exactly

LIT_2.glow_concept: soulstone veins glowing through cracked masonry

motion.description: This is an almost completely still picture. ONLY the cyan cracks across the stone change: they brighten by the smallest amount that is still visible, then return. At their brightest they must still look exactly the same cyan as in the first frame -- never pale, never white, never any other colour. They stay exactly the same size and shape; they never grow and never spread. Nothing is added or removed anywhere, and nothing changes size. Everything else is copied from the first frame exactly, pixel for pixel: same shape, size, position and colour. The last frame matches the first exactly.
